name: Unknown leverage helper unauthenticated onMorphoFlashLoan callback
summary: An unverified leverage helper that EOA 0x85b5bef6 deployed and granted Aave v3 credit delegation exposes onMorphoFlashLoan(uint256,bytes) without checking that the caller is Morpho Blue or that a flash loan is in progress. Any caller can make it repay and re-borrow USDC, borrow USDe on behalf of the delegator and forward caller-supplied calldata to the Pendle router, so attackers had 1.51m USDe borrowed against the delegator's position and added as Pendle PT-pUSDe liquidity with the LP tokens minted to themselves.

loss.notes: Gross USDe borrowed against delegator 0x85b5bef6d57ed80cd2dcce9061e44ff6fae55d31 in the 14 unauthorized transactions and pushed through the helper into the Pendle router with an attacker receiver. Each forced cycle repays and re-borrows 100,000 USDC for the delegator (net zero USDC debt). The 100,000 USDC of Morpho flash-loan capital that the first attacker transaction left in the helper is an attacker-supplied input the owner later swept, so the delegator's net loss is about 1.41m USDe-equivalent; gross depletion is recorded. Merged campaigns: 0x3c34abb66270e0287d138c2cbb69da85cdea3a8e through contract 0x09ecc686ae7068d120fcbbd5034c91d1b66ddf8b (12 transactions, 1.4m USDe, blocks 23476882-23476937), copycat EIP-7702 account 0x08c5aff5f89fed5fc36b660e44393ec4ffa0b1a1 (0xe8bbedf4..9c36, block 23476889, 100,000 USDe) and EOA 0x00138c2862f3b9068320325e44093e190ded2db2 calling the helper directly (0x590e6e09..a16e, block 23477078, 10,000 USDe). The delegator's Aave position stayed solvent, so no protocol bad debt is added.

ageReset.description: Direct, non-upgradeable 3,097-byte runtime deployed by the delegator; the unauthenticated callback is in this runtime from creation.

limitations: The helper has no verified source; the missing caller and flash-loan-state checks are established from execution traces (calls accepted from attacker contract 0x09ecc686.. and directly from EOA 0x00138c28..) rather than from source text.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1: EOA 0x3c34abb66270e0287d138c2cbb69da85cdea3a8e calls its contract 0x09ecc686ae7068d120fcbbd5034c91d1b66ddf8b (created by it at block 23476803, tx 0xfb0fe47a..734a), which takes a 100,000 USDC Morpho Blue flash loan (0xbbbbbbbbbb9cc5e90e3b3af64bdaf62c37eeffcb, selector 0xe0232b42) and, inside its own callback, CALLs helper 0xc1d7d3660354185b224fb98c27cbfdafc4f2b249 with onMorphoFlashLoan(uint256,bytes) selector 0x31f57072 three times (msg.sender = 0x09ecc686.., not Morpho). Calldata: assets 0x174876e800 (100,000 USDC) and data = Pendle router calldata beginning 0xd0f42385 with receiver 0x09ecc686.. and market 0xe49462ffd604d35061fb6937626f675873314c93 (PT-pUSDe-16OCT2025 market, created by Pendle factory 0x1fccc097db89a86bfc474a1028f93958295b1fb7 at block 23016339). Per call the helper runs Aave v3 Pool 0x87870bca3f3fd6335c3f4ce8392d69350b4fa4e2 repay(USDC, 100,000, onBehalfOf 0x85b5bef6d57ed80cd2dcce9061e44ff6fae55d31) (Repay topic 0xa534c8db), borrow(USDe 0x4c9edd5852cd905f086c759e8383e09bff1e68b3, 100,000e18) on behalf of 0x85b5bef6.. (Borrow topic 0xb3d08482, caller = helper via credit delegation), forwards the attacker's data verbatim to Pendle router 0x888888888889758f76e7103c6cbf23abbf58f946 so the USDe becomes SY 0x33e88943b00e699fc5b6597c5f8bcb0872af8bee liquidity whose market LP is minted to 0x09ecc686.., supplies 0.01 PT-sUSDe-27NOV2025 and re-borrows 100,000 USDC. Source-4 (block 23477078) is a direct EOA call from 0x00138c2862f3b9068320325e44093e190ded2db2 to the helper with the same selector and Pendle calldata naming itself as receiver; it succeeds, proving no caller or flash-loan-state check. The runtime contains Ownable selectors and error 0x118cdaa7, so owner gating exists elsewhere but not on this callback. Earliest exercise: eth_getLogs Aave Pool Borrow with topic2 (onBehalfOf) = 0x85b5bef6.., blocks 23475400..23600000, returns 15 transactions; the first, 0xff2b10bcd5654212c82e3ac117f901a7d55ce8475a14b884c8e871ec93c92491 (block 23475524), is the delegator's own entry call (selector 0xf83d6009) borrowing 10m USDe and 10m USDC; every later one is unauthorized and source-1 is the first. Etherscan V2 txlist for the helper shows only creation, that owner call, source-4 and owner approveToken 0x950783b3..a1ea184 (block 23477129). Age: eth_getCode empty at block 23475499; keccak256 0xea955c1f..ade9 (3097 bytes) at 23475500, 23476881 and 23477077; creation receipt 0x12864faf..27b5 at tx index 151 from 0x85b5bef6.. with contractAddress = helper. No DELEGATECALL, EIP-1967 slot or upgrade path appears in the traces; the defect exists from deployment.

Reviewed gross loss. From the Borrow scan in source-2, sum Borrow amounts (data word 1) with topic1 reserve = USDe for onBehalfOf 0x85b5bef6d57ed80cd2dcce9061e44ff6fae55d31 excluding the owner's 0xff2b10bc.. transaction: source-1 300000e18 (3 calls); 100000e18 each in 0xe8bbedf4117a914c38b45a6b3848d49bb1f489907ad1af973d99448d71bf9c36 (block 23476889, from 0x08c5aff5f89fed5fc36b660e44393ec4ffa0b1a1 self-call), 0x0e612ac4.., 0x34beed4a.., 0xcbee0fcb.., 0xb807c0c6.., 0x47aba6dc.., 0xc3903b36.., 0xe1791cfc.., 0xdce410ed.., 0xc0c0fcc5.., 0x3b538522.. and 0x2ad38a30c82f5417164d469443185cffc4a131afd63c86cea3958401701e739f (blocks 23476907-23476937, all from 0x3c34abb6.. to 0x09ecc686.., selector 0x182bdbed); source-4 10000e18. Total 1510000e18 USDe. The matching USDC borrows equal the USDC repays in each transaction. Receipt Transfer logs of source-1 show each borrowed 100,000 USDe moving aUSDe 0x4f5923fc5fd4a93352581b38b7cd26943012decf -> helper -> Pendle router -> SY (logs 14/17/18, 53/56/57, 90/93/94); helper USDe balanceOf is 0 at blocks 23476881, 23476937 and 23477129. getUserAccountData(0x85b5bef6..) totalDebtBase rises from 4001392396824189 (block 23476881) to 4152462234033661 (block 23477078) while totalCollateralBase stays about 4.6467e15; the position remains solvent. The helper's USDC balance becomes 100000e6 in source-1 (Morpho flash-loan USDC supplied by the attacker, log 3, never returned) and 0 by block 23477200 after the owner's approveToken; this attacker input is noted, not deducted.
